# Failing fixture for G-R3 — an exemption with NO rationale.
#
# The clean fixture shows `# unpinned-by-policy: <rationale>` is allowed. This
# fixture is the near miss for that rule: the marker is present but states no
# reason, so it must NOT exempt. Without this case the marker could decay into a
# blanket silence — add `# unpinned-by-policy:` to any line and the gate goes
# quiet — which is the "a check that cannot fail is not a check" failure mode
# (spec §4) expressed inside the exemption itself.
torch==2.14.0+cpu
numpy  # unpinned-by-policy:
